title: Direct image preserves injective abelian sheaves on topological spaces
statement: Let f:Z\to X be a continuous map of topological spaces, and let f_*:Ab(Z)\to Ab(X) be the direct-image functor on abelian sheaves [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology], (f_*F)(U)=F(f^{-1}U). The inverse-image functor f^{-1}:Ab(X)\to Ab(Z) [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] is exact and is left adjoint to f_*. Consequently f_* sends every injective abelian sheaf on Z to an injective abelian sheaf on X [def-sp-injective-resolutions].
